ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: How is Google Ads different from SEO? Which should I do first?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Google Ads buys you visibility at the top of search instantly, so it is the fastest way to start generating leads. SEO builds free, compounding traffic over months. If you need enquiries now, start with Ads; most growing businesses eventually run both, with Ads driving immediate leads while SEO lowers your long-term cost per lead.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: How much should I spend on ads per month to see real results?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: For most local service businesses we recommend starting from R3,000 to R5,000 per month in ad spend, on top of management. That gives Google enough data to optimise and gives us enough signal to improve performance. We will recommend a realistic budget for your industry and goals before you commit.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: Why do I pay you AND Google? Why not just go direct?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Google charges you for the ad clicks; we manage the strategy, structure, tracking and weekly optimisation that stop those clicks being wasted. Run direct without experience and it is easy to burn budget on the wrong keywords. Our fee is designed to make your ad spend work harder than it would on its own.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: Can I cancel if it's not working?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Yes. Every package is month-to-month with no lock-in contract, so you can cancel anytime. We would rather earn your business every month through results than tie you in. In practice, clients stay because the campaigns keep delivering.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: Do I own the Google Ads account?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Always. Your Google Ads account is set up under your ownership, and your ad spend is paid directly to Google, never through us. If we ever part ways, you keep the account, the history and the data. If you pay for it, you own it.

It is our productised routine: every Wednesday we review active accounts and adjust bids, keywords, negative keywords and ad copy based on the week's data. Instead of set-and-forget campaigns, your account gets deliberate attention on a fixed schedule, every week.
